clinical_reasoning_summary: The patient presents with a classic cardiometabolic cluster: documented type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 6.7%, chronic hypertension, hypertriglyceridemia, obesity, and metabolic syndrome. These interrelated conditions drive the high probabilities assigned to diabetes, hypertension, and atherogenic dyslipidaemia. Secondary considerations include obesity‑related sequelae (NAFLD, OSA), chronic anemia likely of disease, and the possibility of subclinical ASCVD given the risk factor load. Mood disorder is added due to the psychosocial impact of multimorbidity. Early CKD was omitted because albuminuria data are lacking.

recommended_workup: Obtain up‑to‑date blood pressure measurements and assess control
Measure weight, height, BMI, and waist circumference
Document smoking and alcohol use history
Order urine albumin‑to‑creatinine ratio to evaluate kidney damage
Repeat comprehensive lipid panel (including LDL, HDL, triglycerides)
Obtain liver function tests (ALT, AST, GGT) to screen for NAFLD
Complete CBC with differential, MCV, reticulocyte count to characterize anemia
Screen for obstructive sleep apnea (STOP‑Bang questionnaire, consider polysomnography)
Administer PHQ‑9 and GAD‑7 questionnaires for depression and anxiety
Consider coronary artery calcium scoring or carotid ultrasound to assess subclinical ASCVD
